title: Implement nationwide required farmer intake without scientific recommendations

acceptance.text: Verify the 64-district directory and implement testable required-answer normalization.
acceptance.evidence: Local National Portal directory checked on 2026-10-30: 64 distinct application IDs across 8 divisions, EN/BN names and source version; intake.js validates and normalizes required/dependent inputs with 17 passing Node tests.
acceptance.how: Verify National Portal district membership/names; create stable application IDs and shared validation/normalization with explicit absence states. No coordinate or scientific defaults.
acceptance.verification: Reject every missing/malformed required/dependent answer; verify 64 unique districts, date consistency, chronology and separate normalized history/baseline/provenance.

acceptance.text: Replace the mounted wizard with bilingual accessible intake and honest summary, preserving drafts and separate demo mode.
acceptance.evidence: Mounted static workspace imports the shared intake modules. Six-question EN/BN form, adjacent/summary errors, genuine draft/submission separation, input-only unavailable summary and explicit separate demo are implemented. UI-controller submit tests pass; native Chrome checked blank errors, district search/keyboard selection, language switching and 400x748 mobile layout. Detailed limits in docs/INTAKE_QA.md.
acceptance.how: Use the actual reference-script workspace, six ordered questions, explicit priority, accessible errors, local genuine drafts and submitted summary. Keep demo mode separate.
acceptance.verification: Mounted form uses shared validator; no mock rankings for intake. Check EN/BN, keyboard/native selection, error focus and mobile wrapping.

acceptance.text: Verify intake behavior, lint, build and workflow records; document scientific dependencies.
acceptance.evidence: 18 Node intake/UI-controller tests, 46 Python workflow tests, three changed-script Node syntax checks, npm lint, webpack production build and workflow check pass. Latest contract/UI/source/task records updated, one Fardin command logged; scientific gates and human review remain unaccepted. Browser checks and not-claimed checks recorded in docs/INTAKE_QA.md.
acceptance.how: Run targeted Node tests/syntax checks, configured lint/build and workflow tests/check; update intake specifications and record the one authorized Fardin instruction.
acceptance.verification: Actual results and limits are recorded, views regenerated, pending G0/G1D/scientific gates stay unaccepted and no commit/push/deploy occurs.
